attempts.text:
**The window opens on the anchor.** Column 0, `fruA`, is a spine column carried by 100% of chromosomes, persistent, in a region of plasticity in 0% of calls. The model names 99.6% of them, at 0.08 bits.

**A short variable stretch follows**, columns 1 to 2, `psuK` to `psuG`, carried by 89 to 90%, [[pseudouridine metabolism]]. Then a spine, columns 7 to 11, `yeiI` to `lysP`, carried by 92 to 94%, fewest named at column 7, 61%. Through columns 28 to 30 a branch of 3 shell families runs in 10%, and through columns 70 to 76 a branch of 7 shell families runs in 10 to 11%.

**The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones**, 96 against 87%, and hesitates less there, 0.19 against 0.54 bits.

**The window ends in fork and variable columns.** Columns 42 to 79 are carried by 41 to 88%, in a region of plasticity in 5 to 78% of calls. The last column is `yegQ`, in 41% of chromosomes.

**Across the window it names 91% of genes**, 0.39 bits on average, perplexity 1.5 families. Inside a region of plasticity it hesitates more than outside, 0.95 against 0.22 bits, and names fewer genes, 75% against 96%.

label: fruA
facts:
[W] WINDOW: the fruA window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor fruA, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 1,543 to 1,622 from dnaA. Read in 539 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying fruA once); 43,120 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
[T] TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
[G] WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 91% of genes, 0.39 bits on average (perplexity 1.5 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 32,236 calls, named 97%, 0.20 bits; shell 10,389 calls, named 76%, 0.81 bits; cloud 495 calls, named 22%, 4.12 bits. Outside an RGP 33,182 calls, named 96%, 0.22 bits; inside an RGP 9,938 calls, named 75%, 0.95 bits. Columns: 34 spine, 14 fork, 32 variable.
[C] COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (0.95 against 0.22 bits) and names fewer genes (75% against 96%); 9,938 of the 43,120 calls are inside an RGP.
[H] HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 28 (yohP, a fork column) 0.85 bits, RGP 10%; column 56 (yehC, a variable column) 0.85 bits, RGP 71%; column 57 (yehB, a variable column) 0.82 bits, RGP 71%. The 17 columns (columns 46-51, 55-58 and 70-76) where most calls are in an RGP: named 83%, 0.65 bits on average; the other 63 columns: named 93%, 0.32 bits.
[M] BY KIND OF COLUMN (computed, over the columns with calls): the 34 spine columns: named 96%, 0.19 bits on average; the 46 fork and variable columns: named 87%, 0.54 bits. The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones, and hesitates less there. Its most hesitant column, 28, is a fork column.
[P] PLASTICITY (the stretches below, by their mean over columns): the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 42-79 (fork and variable columns), RGP 5-78%; the least: column 0 (spine), RGP 0%.
[L] STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
[S1] 1. column 0 spine: share 100%, all P, RGP 0%. Genes: fruA. named 99.6%; 0.08 bits.
[S2] 2. columns 1-2 (2 columns) variable: share 89-90%, all P, RGP 0.2%. named 56-94% (mean 75%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 1, named 56%, 0.46 bits.
[S2.c1]    1: psuK P 89%
[S2.c2]    2: psuG P 90% "pseudouridine-5'-phosphate glycosid…"
[S3] 3. column 3 spine: share 94%, all P, RGP 1%. Genes: psuT. named 97%; 0.16 bits.

[S5] 5. column 5 spine: share 91%, all P, RGP 1%. Genes: rihB. named 96%; 0.15 bits.
[S6] 6. column 6 variable: share 6%, all P, RGP 1%. named 89%; 0.21 bits.
[S6.c6]    6: yeiQ P 6% "mannitol dehydrogenase family prote…"
[S7] 7. columns 7-11 (5 columns) spine: share 92-94%, all P, RGP 1%. Genes: yeiI "sugar kinase", nfo, yeiH "YeiH family protein", yieE "DNA-binding transcriptional regulat…", lysP. named 61-99% (mean 91%), fewest named at column 7 (yeiI), named 61%; no column of this stretch hesitates more than 0.19 bits (column 11 (lysP)).
[S8] 8. column 12 variable: share 85%, all S, RGP 5%. named 92%; 0.64 bits.
